author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: Two-Scale Quotas (k2=2 stitches per other batch)
abstract: Stronger two-scale variant: k2=2 cross-batch 'stitch' edges per other batch added to the equal-quota balanced graph; embedding unchanged. Acceptance only if mean improves or label metrics rise with mixing flat.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

import anndata as ad
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc_twoscale import run_pipeline_twoscale

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline_twoscale(adata,
                                 n_pcs_emb=64, alpha=0.95,
                                 n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.74, lam=0.9, l2=1e-3,
                                 k_total=45, metric='cosine', k2=2)
